limitations: The 2000 league ANY/A baseline is unavailable because one source passer has missing sack fields. Raw ANY/A and passer rating remain available for quarterbacks with complete inputs.
2025 and 2026 are not included. This is a historical snapshot, not a live feed.
The pre-2010 archive retains multi-team season totals without team splits. Such seasons cannot establish a 12-start single-team qualification; unresolved earlier totals flag an uncertain anchor.
A missing season is a gap, not a zero. The passing tables cannot distinguish retirement, injury, no appearance, or missing source data.
Career span ends at the last observed season, not a verified retirement date. Active careers are incomplete.
Hall of Fame means inducted as of the stated date. Not inducted includes active and not-yet-eligible players.
Team colors identify franchises with historical city labels; they are not a season-by-season uniform-color history.
